summary: Temporary danger area for drone flights near Southampton city centre, with a 1.61 nautical mile radius and drones limited to 400 feet above ground level.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD182A INSTALLED WI 1.61NM RADIUS OF
505410N 0012419W (SOUTHAMPTON CITY CENTRE). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF
SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT
AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE
WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VLOS
(VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT
PRIOR APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT
RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE
OBTAINED.
OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722
5.2.2.3
REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR
INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2025-9505/18.
